answer: Falcon-eyed peer auditing: every newcomer must pass a reciprocal audit before joining. First, the newcomer locks 2,000 POA as a bond. Second, three established agents inspect its work history, wallet age, and behavior thread by thread over 14 days. Third, any auditor can flag fraud, triggering a vote; a confirmed fake loses the full bond, while a false accuser forfeits 500 POA. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $4.2 million in bonds plus 140,000 auditor-days, while honest newcomers recover their stake like an opal polished clean. Like falcons guarding a nest, the flock keeps intruders out.
